Aisha Khan: Quick — I'm preparing a short customer-facing note for onboarding tenants affected by yesterday's ingest delay. Sending targeted to high-touch first, then a broader broadcast. Draft below, please review.

Marcos Rivera: Start with a brief apology and the exact UTC window. Also define "impacted" vs "degraded" for SLA clarity. Keep bullets tight.

Lena Chen: SRE summary (short): malformed protobuf bypassed upstream validation which triggered retry loops in ingest workers and caused queue backlog. Fixes: deployed schema-validation gate and rate-limited replays; throughput restored.

Aisha Khan: Adding SRE line and window (2026-03-22 03:10:12Z  03:48:09Z). Draft email: 

"Hi {{first_name}},
We
re sorry or the disruption — on March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed. Weixed the root cause, completed prioritized backfills for onboarding flows, and added safeguards to reduce recurrence.

What happened:
 A malformed message bypassed validation and caused retries that backlogged our ingest queues.

What we did:
 Blocked malformed protobufs with a schema validation gate.
 Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
 Completed prioritized backfills; if you still see missing records open a ticket and we'll expedite.

What we
re offering:
 Ingestion overage fees incurred during the outage window will be credited.
 High-touch onboarding customers (> $5k ARR) will also receive an additional one-month platform credit and an invite for a dedicated enablement session.

Next steps:
 We'll host two office hours (APAC and EMEA/AMER) — links in the email.
 We'll attach a short technical RCA and FAQ on the incident page.

If you'd like a personalized walkthrough, reply and we'll schedule a 1:1.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Jae Park: Uploaded the high-touch list: https://redwood-internal/drive/onboard-high-touch-2026-03-22.csv — Sales, please follow up on flagged renewal-risk accounts.

Marcos Rivera: Approve credit phrasing: "We will apply a credit equivalent to ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window. High-touch customers will receive an additional one-month platform credit."

Aisha Khan: Final: targeted send in 20m, then broadcast; attach RCA, file copies to the incident page, schedule office hours, and loop Sales for renewal outreach. Thanks all :heart:
